items.difficulty_reason: Main assembly lemma of the functor-representation section: chooses a smooth affine presentation, computes C (x)_B C via the Kunneth identification, concludes B -> C faithfully flat, assembles the solid diagram whose top square commutes by fully-faithfulness, and obtains Spec(B) -> X by fpqc descent (proposition-stack-fpqc); the functor-correspondence omissions are named bookkeeping.
